name: home_freshness_lq1392_20261108
comment: Home freshness (LQ-20261107-1392), four defects measured live on 2026-11-08. Pins, at each producer:
(2) TODAY may publish only a session date that could have been a session — marks observed after the
newest opened session are attributed to it and the translation is named, while the observation stays
in marks_observed; an UNKNOWN calendar is never corrected by guess. (3) The VIX complex merges by
SESSION: a carried Schwab print newer than FRED's T+1 observation wins (both values stay on the
payload), so Friday's VIX close reaches the volatility category on a Sunday instead of being refused as
stale Thursday FRED; the same fixture without Friday is still UNKNOWN and names the date it used, and a
missing series is UNKNOWN, never a zero. (4) A quote-derived close is provisional only while ITS session
was still open at `end`, so a completed session reaches reentry_stages instead of vanishing behind the
provisional filter; an after-hours print is still not the close. Synthetic fixtures only (ZZQ/QQQ/SPY
shapes, invented prices); no DB, no network. The renderer half is
